title: 中考2000词·60篇短文背诵（原创）

items.sent: My School Day. I usually get up at half past six. After a quick breakfast, I ride my bicycle to school. The first lesson begins at eight. I like English best because my teacher always makes the class interesting. At noon, I have lunch with my classmates in the dining hall. In the afternoon, we have maths, art and PE. After school, I do my homework first, then practise the piano for half an hour. I go to bed early every night.
items.sentZh: 我的校园一天。我通常六点半起床。匆匆吃过早饭后，我骑自行车去上学。第一节课八点开始。我最喜欢英语，因为老师总能把课堂变得有趣。中午，我和同学们在食堂一起吃午饭。下午我们上数学、美术和体育课。放学后我先做作业，然后练半小时钢琴。每晚我都早早睡觉。

items.sent: My Best Friend. Li Ming is my best friend. We have known each other since primary school. He is tall and thin, with short black hair and a bright smile. He is not only clever but also helpful. When I feel sad or nervous before exams, he always encourages me. We often play basketball together at weekends. Sometimes we borrow interesting books from the library and talk about them. I believe our friendship will last forever.
items.sentZh: 我最好的朋友。李明是我最好的朋友。我们从小学起就互相认识。他又高又瘦，留着黑色短发，笑容灿烂。他不仅聪明，还很乐于助人。每当我在考试前难过或紧张时，他总是鼓励我。周末我们常常一起打篮球，有时还从图书馆借有趣的书来讨论。我相信我们的友谊会天长地久。

items.sent: My Family. There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my little brother and I. My father is an engineer who works in a factory. My mother is a nurse; she looks after patients carefully every day. My brother is only five years old, and he likes drawing pictures of animals. Although we sometimes argue about small things, we love each other deeply. On Sunday evenings, we cook dinner together and share our stories of the week.
items.sentZh: 我的家庭。我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。爸爸是一名工程师，在工厂工作。妈妈是护士，每天细心地照顾病人。弟弟只有五岁，喜欢画动物。虽然我们有时会为小事争吵，但我们深深地爱着彼此。星期天晚上，我们会一起做晚饭，分享这一周的故事。

items.sent: A Trip to the Countryside. Last Saturday, my classmates and I visited a small village in the mountains. The air was fresh and the sky was blue. Farmers were busy working in the fields, and sheep were eating grass on the hill. An old farmer showed us around his farm and taught us how to feed the chickens and pick fresh vegetables. We also helped water the plants. When the sun went down, we said goodbye to the kind farmer and went home happily.
items.sentZh: 乡村之行。上周六，我和同学们参观了山里的一个小村庄。空气清新，天空湛蓝。农民们在田里忙着干活，羊儿在山坡上吃草。一位老农带我们参观了他的农场，教我们喂鸡、摘新鲜蔬菜，我们还帮忙浇了菜。太阳落山时，我们跟善良的农夫道别，高高兴兴地回家了。

items.sent: The Spring Festival. The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. It usually comes in January or February. Before the festival, people clean their houses and buy new clothes. On New Year's Eve, the whole family gets together and enjoys a big dinner. We eat dumplings and fish, and watch a wonderful show on TV. Children receive lucky money from their elders. Everyone laughs and talks, and the streets are crowded with happy people.
items.sentZh: 春节。春节是中国最重要的传统节日，通常在一月或二月。节前人们打扫房子、买新衣服。除夕夜全家人团聚，享用丰盛的晚餐。我们吃饺子和鱼，看精彩的电视节目。孩子们会收到长辈的压岁钱。人人欢声笑语，街上挤满了幸福的人们。

items.sent: My Favourite Sport. Swimming is my favourite sport. I started to learn it when I was seven years old. At first, I was afraid of the water, but my coach was patient and taught me step by step. Now I can swim quite well. Swimming is good for both my body and my mind. After swimming, I always feel relaxed and full of energy. In summer, I go to the pool three times a week with my father.
items.sentZh: 我最喜爱的运动。游泳是我最喜欢的运动。我七岁开始学游泳。起初我怕水，但教练很有耐心，一步一步地教我。现在我已经游得很好了。游泳对我的身心都有好处。每次游完泳，我都觉得放松、充满活力。夏天，我每周和爸爸去游泳馆游三次。

items.sent: Keeping Healthy. Health is more important than anything else. To keep healthy, we should go to bed early and get enough sleep. Eating more vegetables and fruit and less junk food is also necessary. We'd better drink enough water every day. Exercise plays an important part in our life, so I run for twenty minutes every morning. Besides, we should keep our rooms clean and wash our hands before meals. If we do these things, we will hardly ever get ill.
items.sentZh: 保持健康。健康比什么都重要。要保持健康，我们应该早睡、睡眠充足；多吃蔬菜水果、少吃垃圾食品也很必要；每天最好喝足够的水。运动在生活中扮演着重要角色，所以我每天早晨跑步二十分钟。此外，还要保持房间干净、饭前洗手。做到这些，我们几乎不会生病。

items.sent: A Rainy Day. It rained heavily on my way home yesterday. I didn't take an umbrella, so I ran into a bookshop to keep dry. While I was waiting, I found an interesting novel about travelling. I sat down and read a few pages. Suddenly, a kind girl offered to share her umbrella with me. We walked and talked all the way to my building. Although it was a wet and cold day, my heart felt warm.
items.sentZh: 雨天。昨天回家的路上下起了大雨。我没带伞，只好跑进一家书店避雨。等待的时候，我发现了一本有趣的旅行小说，坐下来读了几页。忽然，一个好心的女孩主动提出和我共撑一把伞。我们一路边走边聊，一直走到我家楼下。虽然那是一个又湿又冷的日子，我心里却暖暖的。

items.sent: My Little Dog. I have a lovely dog named Doudou. He has brown hair, big eyes and a short tail. Every morning he wakes me up on time. When I come home from school, he always runs to the door and jumps happily around me. I feed him twice a day and walk him after dinner. He is clever and can understand simple words like sit and stand. He is not just a pet but a true friend of mine.
items.sentZh: 我的小狗。我有一只可爱的小狗，叫豆豆。它棕色的毛、大大的眼睛、短短的尾巴。每天早晨它准时叫醒我。我放学回家时，它总是跑到门口，围着我开心地蹦跳。我一天喂它两次，晚饭后带它散步。它很聪明，能听懂“坐下”“站起来”这样简单的口令。它不只是宠物，更是我真正的朋友。

items.sent: Shopping with Mum. On Saturday morning, I went shopping with my mum in the supermarket. We bought a lot of things: meat, eggs, tomatoes and milk. Mum taught me how to choose fresh fruit. The shop was full of people because there was a big sale. I helped Mum carry the heavy bags. At the checkout, we waited in line patiently. I think it is important to learn how to shop wisely and save money.
items.sentZh: 和妈妈购物。星期六上午，我和妈妈去超市购物。我们买了肉、鸡蛋、西红柿和牛奶等许多东西。妈妈教我怎样挑选新鲜水果。因为正赶上大减价，超市里挤满了人。我帮妈妈提沉重的购物袋，在收银台耐心地排队。我觉得学会聪明购物、节约花钱很重要。

items.sent: The Library. Our school library is a quiet and bright place. There are thousands of books on different subjects, such as science, history and art. Students can borrow three books at a time and keep them for two weeks. In the reading room, everyone must keep quiet and put the books back after reading. I often go there after class. Reading opens a window to the world for me and makes me smarter and happier.
items.sentZh: 图书馆。我们学校的图书馆安静又明亮，有数千本不同学科的书，比如科学、历史和美术。学生一次可以借三本书，保留两周。在阅览室里，每个人都必须保持安静，读完把书放回原处。我经常课后去那里。阅读为我打开了一扇通向世界的窗，让我更聪明、更快乐。

items.sent: A Birthday Party. Last Sunday was my thirteenth birthday. In the evening, my parents held a party for me at home. They invited my grandparents, my uncle and several friends. My mother cooked many delicious dishes and my father bought a big chocolate cake. My friends sang the birthday song and I made a wish before blowing out the candles. I also received some lovely presents. It was really an unforgettable evening.
items.sentZh: 生日聚会。上周日是我十三岁生日。晚上，爸妈在家里为我举办了聚会，邀请了我的爷爷奶奶、叔叔和几个朋友。妈妈做了很多美味的菜，爸爸买了一个大巧克力蛋糕。朋友们唱起生日歌，我在吹蜡烛前许了愿，还收到了一些可爱的礼物。那真是一个难忘的夜晚。

items.sent: Winter in the North. Winter in the north of China is long and cold. When snow falls, the whole city turns white and beautiful. Children love making snowmen and having snowball fights in the park. The lakes freeze, and some people even go skating on the ice. We wear thick coats, scarves and gloves to keep warm. Although winter is freezing, it brings us so much fun.
items.sentZh: 北方的冬天。中国北方的冬天漫长而寒冷。下雪时，整座城市变得洁白美丽。孩子们喜欢在公园里堆雪人、打雪仗。湖水结冰，有些人甚至去冰上滑冰。我们穿上厚外套，戴上围巾和手套保暖。虽然冬天寒冷刺骨，却带给我们许多乐趣。

items.sent: My Dream Job. When I grow up, I want to be a doctor. In my eyes, doctors are great because they save people's lives. During the hard fight against illness, many doctors worked day and night without rest. I respect them from the bottom of my heart. To make my dream come true, I must study hard, especially science, and learn to be careful and brave. I will never give up trying.
items.sentZh: 我的理想职业。长大后我想当一名医生。在我看来，医生很伟大，因为他们拯救人的生命。在艰苦的抗病战斗中，许多医生日夜工作、不知休息。我打心底里尊敬他们。为了实现梦想，我必须努力学习，尤其是科学，还要学会细心和勇敢。我将永不放弃努力。

items.sent: Helping Others. Helping others is a happy thing. One morning, I saw an old lady carrying a heavy bag on a crowded bus. I stood up at once and offered her my seat. She thanked me with a warm smile. On another day, I helped a little boy find his mother in the supermarket. These small things cost nothing but bring sunshine to others. If everyone is ready to help, the world will become better.
items.sentZh: 帮助他人。帮助别人是一件快乐的事。一天早晨，在拥挤的公交车上，我看见一位提着重物的老奶奶，立刻站起来把座位让给了她，她带着温暖的微笑向我道谢。还有一天，我在超市帮一个小男孩找到了妈妈。这些小事不花分文，却能给别人带去阳光。如果人人都乐于助人，世界会变得更美好。

items.sent: The Internet and Me. The Internet has become an important part of our daily life. I often use it to search for information, watch English movies and listen to music. It also helps me keep in touch with my cousins in other cities. However, spending too much time online is bad for our eyes and study. Some students even play computer games all night. I usually use the Internet for less than an hour a day and never visit unhealthy websites.
items.sentZh: 互联网与我。互联网已成为我们日常生活的重要部分。我常用它查资料、看英文电影、听音乐，它还帮我和其他城市的表哥表姐们保持联系。然而，上网时间太长对眼睛和学习都有害，有些学生甚至通宵打游戏。我每天上网不超过一小时，从不浏览不健康的网站。

items.sent: A Visit to the Museum. Last month our class visited the Science Museum. The guide showed us many old machines and modern inventions. The most interesting part was the robot show: a robot could dance and answer questions! We also watched an exciting film about space in a huge round hall. I wrote down lots of notes because I want to be a scientist in the future. The visit taught me more than any textbook.
items.sentZh: 参观博物馆。上个月我们班参观了科技馆。讲解员带我们看了许多古老的机器和现代发明。最有意思的是机器人表演：一个机器人会跳舞、能回答问题！我们还在巨大的圆形大厅里看了一部关于太空的精彩电影。我记了很多笔记，因为我想将来成为科学家。这次参观教给我的比任何课本都多。

items.sent: Planting Trees. March the twelfth is Tree Planting Day in China. Last year, our whole class went to the hills behind our town to plant trees. First we dug holes, then we put the young trees in and filled the holes with earth. Finally we watered them. It was hard work and everyone was tired and dirty, but we felt proud. Trees can clean the air and make our environment beautiful, so we should protect them.
items.sentZh: 植树。3月12日是中国的植树节。去年，我们全班去镇子后面的山上植树。先挖坑，再把小树苗放进坑里培上土，最后浇水。活儿很累，每个人都又累又脏，但我们感到自豪。树木能净化空气、美化环境，所以我们应该保护它们。

items.sent: My English Teacher. Miss Wang is our English teacher. She is in her thirties, with glasses and long hair. Her classes are lively and full of games, songs and short plays. She never gets angry when we make mistakes; instead, she smiles and corrects us patiently. She often tells us that practice makes perfect. With her help, my English has improved a lot. All of my classmates love and respect her.
items.sentZh: 我的英语老师。王老师是我们的英语老师。她三十多岁，戴眼镜，留长发。她的课堂生动活泼，充满游戏、歌曲和小短剧。我们犯错时她从不生气，而是微笑着耐心纠正。她常告诉我们“熟能生巧”。在她的帮助下，我的英语进步很大。全班同学都爱戴并尊敬她。

items.sent: The Mid-Autumn Festival. The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month. On that day, the moon is round and bright. Family members get together and have a big dinner. After the meal, we sit in the yard, eat mooncakes and enjoy the beautiful moonlight. Grandpa often tells old stories about the moon. The round moon and round mooncakes both stand for family reunion. That is why I love this festival so much.
items.sentZh: 中秋节。中秋节在农历八月十五。那天的月亮又圆又亮。家人团聚吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。饭后，我们坐在院子里吃月饼、欣赏美丽的月光。爷爷常讲关于月亮的老故事。圆圆的月亮和圆圆的月饼都象征着团圆，这就是我如此喜爱这个节日的原因。

items.sent: A Football Match. Last Friday afternoon, our school had an exciting football match against Class Five. Hundreds of students watched around the playground and shouted for their teams. Our team fought hard from the beginning. In the last five minutes, our captain passed the ball quickly and kicked it into the goal. We won the match at last! All of us jumped and cheered. Teamwork and practice brought us the victory.
items.sentZh: 一场足球赛。上周五下午，我们学校和五班进行了一场激动人心的足球赛。数百名学生围在操场边为各自的队伍呐喊助威。我们的队伍从一开始就奋力拼搏。最后五分钟，队长快速传球，把球踢进了球门。我们最终赢得了比赛！大家欢呼雀跃。团队合作和日常训练为我们带来了胜利。

items.sent: Good Eating Habits. Many students like eating snacks, fried chicken and sweet drinks, but these are bad for health. Good eating habits are very important. We should have three meals on time, especially breakfast, which gives us energy for the morning. Eat more vegetables, fruit and grain, and less sugar and salt. Don't eat too much before going to bed. Drinking a glass of milk every day also helps us grow strong.
items.sentZh: 良好的饮食习惯。很多学生喜欢吃零食、炸鸡和甜饮料，但这些对健康有害。良好的饮食习惯非常重要。三餐要按时吃，尤其是早餐，它为我们上午提供能量。多吃蔬菜、水果和谷物，少吃糖和盐；睡前不要吃太多。每天喝一杯牛奶也有助于我们长得强壮。

items.sent: Travelling by Train. During the summer holiday, I travelled to Beijing by train with my parents. It was my first long trip by train. The train ran fast and smoothly, and it took only five hours. Through the window I saw green fields, rivers, bridges and small villages. I ate snacks, played cards and chatted with my parents on the way. Travelling by train is cheap, safe and comfortable, and we can enjoy the views at the same time.
items.sentZh: 乘火车旅行。暑假里，我和父母乘火车去北京旅行。这是我第一次坐火车长途旅行。火车跑得又快又稳，只用了五个小时。透过车窗，我看到了绿色的田野、河流、桥梁和小村庄。一路上我吃零食、打牌、和父母聊天。乘火车旅行便宜、安全又舒适，还能同时欣赏风景。

items.sent: Reading Is My Hobby. Reading is my favourite hobby. I started reading picture books when I was four. Now I enjoy stories, science books and magazines. Every evening I read for half an hour before sleep. Books take me to different places and times and teach me a lot about the world. They also help me write better compositions. My mother often says that books are our best friends.
items.sentZh: 读书——我的爱好。阅读是我最喜欢的爱好。我四岁就开始读图画书了。现在我喜欢故事书、科普书和杂志。每天晚上睡前我都读半小时。书带我走进不同的地方和时代，教给我许多关于世界的知识，还帮我写出更好的作文。妈妈常说，书是我们最好的朋友。

items.sent: The Seasons. There are four seasons in a year, and each has its own beauty. In spring, everything comes back to life and flowers come out everywhere. Summer is hot, and the days are long. It is the best time for swimming. In autumn, the leaves turn yellow and farmers are busy harvesting. Winter is cold and quiet, and snow covers the ground. My favourite season is autumn because the weather is cool and comfortable.
items.sentZh: 四季。一年有四季，每个季节都有自己的美。春天万物复苏，鲜花处处开放。夏天炎热，白昼很长，正是游泳的好时节。秋天树叶变黄，农民忙着收割。冬天寒冷而安静，大雪覆盖大地。我最喜欢的季节是秋天，因为天气凉爽舒适。

items.sent: A Day at the Beach. Last summer, my family spent a whole day at the beach. The sea was blue and the sand was soft and warm. My brother and I built sand castles and collected shells near the water. Father swam far out, while Mother sat under a big umbrella reading a magazine. At noon we had a picnic and ate ice cream. When the tide came in, we had to say goodbye to the sea. What a wonderful day!
items.sentZh: 海边的一天。去年夏天，我们全家在海边玩了一整天。大海湛蓝，沙滩柔软温暖。我和弟弟堆沙堡、在水边捡贝壳。爸爸游到很远的地方，妈妈坐在大遮阳伞下看杂志。中午我们野餐，还吃了冰淇淋。涨潮时，我们只好和大海说再见。多么美好的一天！

items.sent: My Bedroom. My bedroom is small but clean and comfortable. There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf in it. On the desk there is a lamp and my computer. I do my homework and read books there every evening. Above the bed hangs a picture of the sea. I put all my books and toys in order, so I can find them easily. I clean my room myself every week. I love my own little world.
items.sentZh: 我的卧室。我的卧室不大，但干净舒适。房间里有一张床、一张书桌和一个书架。桌上有台灯和电脑。每天晚上我都在那里写作业、读书。床的上方挂着一幅大海的画。我把所有的书和玩具摆放整齐，找起来很方便。我每周自己打扫房间。我爱我的小天地。

items.sent: How I Learn English. English is not easy, but I have some useful ways to learn it well. First, I listen to the tape and read aloud every morning. Second, I keep a diary in English to practise writing. Third, when I meet new words, I look them up in a dictionary instead of giving up. Watching English cartoons is also helpful. Little by little, my English is getting better. Remember: where there is a will, there is a way.
items.sentZh: 我如何学英语。英语并不容易，但我有一些学好它的好方法。第一，每天早晨听录音、大声朗读；第二，坚持用英语写日记来练习写作；第三，遇到生词就查词典，而不是放弃。看英文动画片也很有帮助。渐渐地，我的英语越来越好。记住：有志者事竟成。

items.sent: A Kind Bus Driver. One evening, an old man fell down suddenly on our bus. The driver stopped the bus right away and asked if he was all right. Then he drove the old man to the nearest hospital as fast as possible without thinking twice. Luckily, the doctor said the old man was fine. All the passengers praised the driver. From him I learned that kindness and a warm heart can light up the world.
items.sentZh: 善良的公交车司机。一天晚上，一位老人在我们乘坐的公交车上突然摔倒。司机立刻停车，询问他是否还好，然后毫不犹豫地以最快的速度把老人送到了最近的医院。幸运的是，医生说老人没有大碍。全体乘客都称赞这位司机。从他身上我明白：善良和热心能照亮世界。

items.sent: The Dragon Boat Festival. The Dragon Boat Festival is on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. It has a history of more than two thousand years. On that day, people eat zongzi, a kind of traditional food made of rice, and hold exciting dragon boat races on the river. The festival is in memory of Qu Yuan, a great poet who loved his country deeply. Every year I watch the races on TV with my family.
items.sentZh: 端午节。端午节在农历五月初五，已有两千多年的历史。那一天，人们吃粽子——一种用米做的传统食物，还在河上举行激动人心的龙舟比赛。这个节日是为了纪念深爱祖国的伟大诗人屈原。每年我都和家人一起在电视上看龙舟赛。

items.sent: Saving Water. Water is important for all living things, but many places in the world are short of water. We must save every drop. At home, we should turn off the tap after washing hands and reuse water to clean the floor or water the flowers. At school, we should report broken taps in time. Remember: never throw rubbish into rivers or lakes. If everyone saves a little water every day, our world will be much better.
items.sentZh: 节约用水。水对所有生物都很重要，但世界上许多地方缺水。我们必须节约每一滴水。在家，洗完手要关紧水龙头，用过的水可以拖地或浇花；在学校，发现水龙头坏了要及时报告。记住：千万不要往河流湖泊里扔垃圾。如果人人每天节约一点水，我们的世界会更美好。

items.sent: My Grandpa's Garden. My grandpa has a small garden behind his house. He grows tomatoes, potatoes, cabbages and all kinds of flowers there. Every morning he gets up early, waters the plants and pulls out the grass. In autumn, he often sends us fresh vegetables. Grandpa says plants are like children: if you look after them carefully, they will give you surprises. Working in the garden keeps him healthy and happy.
items.sentZh: 爷爷的菜园。爷爷在房后有一个小菜园，里面种着西红柿、土豆、卷心菜和各种花。每天清晨他早早起床，给植物浇水、拔草。秋天，他常给我们送来新鲜蔬菜。爷爷说，植物就像孩子：细心照料，它们就会给你惊喜。打理菜园让他健康又快乐。

items.sent: An Unforgettable Lesson. Last term, I forgot to do my maths homework and copied my deskmate's answers. My teacher found it out, but she didn't shout at me. She asked me to stay after class and told me a story about honesty. Her words touched my heart deeply. I said sorry and promised never to cheat again. From then on, I always finish my homework by myself. This lesson taught me to be an honest person.
items.sentZh: 难忘的一课。上学期，我忘了做数学作业，抄了同桌的答案。老师发现了，但她没有吼我，而是让我课后留下，给我讲了一个关于诚实的故事。她的话深深打动了我。我道了歉，保证再也不作弊。从那以后，我总是独立完成作业。这一课教会我做一个诚实的人。

items.sent: The Weather Report. Here is the weather report for tomorrow. It will be sunny in the morning in most areas, so it is a good time for outdoor activities. In the afternoon, clouds will appear and there will be a light rain in the south. The temperature will drop to ten degrees at night, so please wear warm clothes. People in the northern mountains should be careful, because the wind may be quite strong. Thank you for listening.
items.sentZh: 天气预报。下面是明天的天气预报。上午大部分地区晴，适合户外活动。下午多云，南部有小雨。夜间气温将降到十度，请注意保暖。北部山区风力可能较大，请当心。感谢收听。

items.sent: Going to the Doctor. Yesterday I had a bad headache and a sore throat, so my mother took me to the hospital. The doctor asked me some questions and took my temperature. He said I had caught a bad cold and gave me some medicine. He told me to take the medicine three times a day, drink more warm water and rest in bed. Now I feel much better. I will do more exercise to keep fit.
items.sentZh: 看医生。昨天我头疼得厉害，嗓子也疼，妈妈带我去了医院。医生问了一些问题，量了体温，说我得了重感冒，开了些药，嘱咐我一天服三次药、多喝温水、卧床休息。现在我好多了。我要多锻炼，保持健康。

items.sent: My Cousin from Canada. During the summer holidays, my cousin Jack came to China from Canada. It was his first time in Beijing, so we took him to the Great Wall, the Palace Museum and some beautiful parks. He was amazed at everything and took hundreds of photos. At first he couldn't use chopsticks, but now he can pick up dumplings! He taught me English, and I taught him Chinese. We had a great time together.
items.sentZh: 来自加拿大的表哥。暑假里，表哥杰克从加拿大来到中国。这是他第一次到北京，我们带他去了长城、故宫和一些美丽的公园。他对一切都惊叹不已，拍了几百张照片。起初他不会用筷子，现在居然能夹起饺子了！他教我英语，我教他中文。我们一起度过了美好的时光。

items.sent: The School Sports Meeting. Our school sports meeting was held last Thursday. Hundreds of students took part in different events, such as running, high jump and long jump. I joined the 800-metre race. At first I ran fast, but in the middle I felt tired and wanted to stop. My classmates shouted loudly to cheer me on. Their voices gave me strength. In the end I got second place. I understood that never giving up is the key to success.
items.sentZh: 校运动会。上周四我们学校举行了运动会。数百名学生参加了跑步、跳高、跳远等不同项目。我参加了800米赛跑。起初我跑得很快，但中途感到疲惫，想停下来。同学们大声为我加油，他们的喊声给了我力量。最后我获得了第二名。我明白了：永不放弃是成功的关键。

items.sent: Books and the Internet. Some people think reading paper books is out of date because the Internet is fast and easy. However, I don't fully agree. The Internet is good for finding news quickly, but reading books helps us think deeply and quietly. A paper book does not need electricity, and it protects our eyes better than screens. My way is to use both: search online, then read books carefully. In this way, we can enjoy the advantages of both worlds.
items.sentZh: 书与网络。有人认为读纸质书已经过时，因为网络快捷方便。但我不完全同意。网络适合快速查找新闻，而读书能让我们深入而安静地思考。纸质书不需要电，比屏幕更护眼。我的方法是两者都用：先上网搜索，再仔细读书。这样就能同时享受两个世界的优点。

items.sent: A Picnic in the Park. Last Sunday the weather was fine, so our class had a picnic in People's Park. We rode there by bike. Some students put up the tent, some carried water, and others prepared food. We brought bread, sandwiches, fruit and juice. After lunch, we played games, sang songs and flew kites on the grass. Before leaving, we picked up all the rubbish and kept the park clean. Everyone enjoyed the happy day in nature.
items.sentZh: 公园野餐。上周日天气晴好，我们班在人民公园野餐。我们骑自行车过去。有的同学搭帐篷，有的提水，其他人准备食物。我们带了面包、三明治、水果和果汁。午饭后，我们在草地上做游戏、唱歌、放风筝。离开前，我们捡起所有垃圾，保持公园整洁。大家都享受了大自然中快乐的一天。

items.sent: City Life and Country Life. Life in the city and the country is quite different. Cities are big and modern, with tall buildings, busy streets and large supermarkets. It is easy to study and shop there, but the air is sometimes dirty and life is noisy. In the country, the air is fresh, the mountains are green and people live quietly. Many city people like to spend their holidays in villages. I enjoy both, because each has its own beauty.
items.sentZh: 城市生活与乡村生活。城市和乡村的生活大不相同。城市宏大而现代，有高楼、繁忙的街道和大超市，在那里学习和购物都很方便，但空气有时污浊，生活喧闹。乡村空气清新、山峦翠绿、生活宁静，许多城里人喜欢去村里度假。两种生活我都喜欢，因为各有各的美。

items.sent: My Favourite Subject. Of all my subjects, I like science best. It opens my eyes to the amazing world. In class, we do interesting experiments and find out how things work. Once our teacher showed us how to make a small model plane, and it really flew! Science is sometimes difficult, but when I solve a problem, I feel really excited. I hope to become a scientist and invent useful things for people in the future.
items.sentZh: 我最喜欢的学科。在所有学科中，我最喜欢科学。它让我看到世界的奇妙。课堂上，我们做有趣的实验，弄清事物运行的原理。有一次老师教我们做小飞机模型，它真的飞起来了！科学有时很难，但每当我解开一道难题，就特别兴奋。我希望将来成为科学家，为人们发明有用的东西。

items.sent: The Power of Smiling. A smile may be small, but its power is great. When you meet your teachers and friends in the morning, a sweet smile says hello better than words. When your classmates feel nervous or fail an exam, your smile gives them warmth and courage. Smiling can also make strangers become friends quickly. It costs nothing but brings light to others. So let's smile at life every day, even when times are hard.
items.sentZh: 微笑的力量。微笑虽小，力量却很大。早晨见到老师和朋友时，一个甜甜的微笑比言语更好地表达问候；当同学紧张或考试失利时，你的微笑给他们温暖和勇气。微笑还能让陌生人很快变成朋友。它分文不花，却给别人带去光亮。所以，即使日子艰难，也让我们每天微笑面对生活。

items.sent: A Lost Wallet. One evening after school, I found a wallet on the ground near the school gate. There was much money and an ID card in it. I thought the owner must be very worried. So I waited there and asked my teacher for help. Through the information on the card, we soon found the owner, a young man. He was so thankful that he wanted to give me money, but I refused. Being honest made me feel proud and happy.
items.sentZh: 丢失的钱包。一天傍晚放学后，我在校门口的地上捡到一个钱包，里面有很多钱和一张身份证。我想失主一定很着急，于是在原地等候，并请老师帮忙。通过卡片上的信息，我们很快找到了失主——一位年轻人。他非常感激，想给我钱作为酬谢，我谢绝了。诚实让我感到自豪和快乐。

items.sent: Computer Games: Good or Bad?. Many students love playing computer games. In some ways, games can help us relax and even train our brains and reactions. However, if we spend too much time playing, our eyesight may get worse and our grades will drop. Some children even lie to their parents about games. In my opinion, we can play games for a short time at weekends, but study and health must come first. Learning to control ourselves is the most important.
items.sentZh: 电脑游戏：是好是坏？。许多学生爱玩电脑游戏。从某些方面说，游戏能帮助我们放松，甚至锻炼大脑和反应能力。然而，如果玩的时间太长，视力会下降，成绩也会滑坡。有些孩子甚至为了游戏对父母撒谎。依我看，周末可以适当玩一会儿，但学习和健康必须放在首位。学会自我控制才是最重要的。

items.sent: The Zoo Visit. Last weekend my little sister and I visited the city zoo. We saw many animals: strong lions, tall giraffes, playful monkeys and fat pandas eating bamboo. The pandas were the most popular; everyone loved their funny actions. My sister was afraid of the huge elephants at first, but later she fed them apples. At the bird house, we enjoyed the colourful parrots talking. Animals are our friends, and we should protect them instead of hurting them.
items.sentZh: 动物园之行。上周末，我和妹妹参观了市动物园。我们看到了许多动物：威武的狮子、高大的长颈鹿、顽皮的猴子，还有正吃竹子的胖熊猫。熊猫最受欢迎，人人都喜欢它们憨态可掬的样子。妹妹起初害怕巨大的大象，后来还喂它们苹果呢。在鸟馆，我们欣赏了会说话的彩色鹦鹉。动物是我们的朋友，我们应该保护而不是伤害它们。

items.sent: Mother's Day. Mother's Day falls on the second Sunday of May. This year I decided to do something special for my mother. In the morning I got up early and cooked breakfast for her. Then I cleaned the house and washed the dishes. I also made a beautiful card with my own hands and wrote: Thank you, Mum, I love you. When she read the words, tears came into her eyes. Helping parents makes us grow.
items.sentZh: 母亲节。母亲节是五月的第二个星期日。今年我决定为妈妈做点特别的事。早晨我早早起床为她做早餐，然后打扫房间、洗碗。我还亲手做了一张漂亮的卡片，写下：“谢谢您，妈妈，我爱您。”当她读到这些话时，眼里噙满泪水。为父母分忧让我们成长。

items.sent: Walking to School. My home is not far from the school, so I walk there every day. It takes about fifteen minutes. On my way, I pass a small river, a bakery and a busy street. In spring, flowers come out along the river, and birds sing in the trees. Walking not only keeps me healthy but also helps me wake up fully. Besides, walking causes no pollution, so it is friendly to our environment.
items.sentZh: 步行上学。我家离学校不远，所以我每天步行上学，大约需要十五分钟。路上要经过一条小河、一家面包店和一条热闹的街道。春天，河边鲜花开放，鸟儿在树上歌唱。步行不仅让我保持健康，还帮我完全清醒。而且步行没有污染，对环境友好。

items.sent: The Moon and Stars. At night, the sky is like a huge black curtain covered with shining diamonds. The moon is the brightest of them all. It changes its shape every week, from a thin sickle to a round plate. Long ago, people told many beautiful stories about the moon. Today scientists have even walked on it. When I feel lonely, I look up at the stars, and they quietly keep me company like old friends.
items.sentZh: 月亮和星星。夜晚，天空像一块缀满闪亮钻石的巨大黑色幕布。月亮是其中最亮的。它每周变换形状，从细细的月牙变成圆圆的玉盘。很久以前，人们讲过许多关于月亮的美丽故事；今天，科学家们甚至已经在月球上行走过。当我感到孤独时，就抬头望星星，它们像老朋友一样静静地陪伴着我。

items.sent: My Classmates. There are forty-five students in my class, and each of them is special. Li Hua is the tallest and plays basketball best. Wang Fang draws wonderful pictures and wants to be an artist. Tom is humorous and always tells jokes that make us laugh. Our monitor is serious and responsible; she helps the teacher manage the class well. We may be different, but we help each other like a big family. I love my classmates.
items.sentZh: 我的同学们。我们班有四十五名学生，每个人都有自己的特点。李华个子最高，篮球打得最好；王芳画画出色，想当画家；汤姆很幽默，总讲笑话逗我们笑；班长认真负责，帮老师把班级管理得井井有条。我们各不相同，却像一个大家庭一样互相帮助。我爱我的同学们。

items.sent: Protecting Animals. Animals are humans' friends, but many of them are in danger now. Some people kill animals for their fur or meat, and some cut down forests, so animals lose their homes. If this goes on, we will never see tigers, elephants or some birds again. To protect animals, we should say no to fur clothes and protect the environment. It is everyone's duty to keep the balance of nature. Let's act now!
items.sentZh: 保护动物。动物是人类的朋友，但如今许多动物正濒临危险。有人为了毛皮或肉而捕杀动物，有人砍伐森林，使动物失去家园。这样下去，我们将再也见不到老虎、大象和一些鸟类。为了保护动物，我们应该对皮草制品说不，并保护环境。维持自然平衡是每个人的责任。让我们行动起来吧！

items.sent: The First Snow. When I woke up this morning, the world outside was completely white. It had snowed all night! This was the first snow of the winter. I hurried through breakfast and ran outside. The snow was deep and soft, and my shoes left little holes on it. My friends and I had a big snowball fight and made a snowman with a carrot nose. Though my hands were freezing, nothing could stop our laughter.
items.sentZh: 第一场雪。今天早晨醒来时，外面的世界一片洁白——下了一整夜的雪！这是今冬的第一场雪。我匆匆吃完早饭就跑了出去。雪又深又软，我的鞋在上面留下一个个小坑。我和朋友们打了一场大大的雪仗，还堆了一个插着胡萝卜鼻子的雪人。虽然手都冻僵了，但没有什么能挡住我们的笑声。

items.sent: Making Dumplings. On New Year's Eve, the whole family got together to make dumplings. Grandma prepared the dough, and Mum mixed the meat with cabbage to make the filling. I learned to put the filling in the middle of the wrapper and press the edges together. My first dumplings looked strange, but they got better and better. Grandpa hid a coin in one dumpling for good luck. Cooking with family is full of warmth and laughter.
items.sentZh: 包饺子。除夕夜，全家人聚在一起包饺子。奶奶和面，妈妈把肉和白菜拌成馅。我学着把馅放在饺子皮中间，再把边缘捏紧。我最初的几个饺子样子怪怪的，但越包越好。爷爷还在一个饺子里藏了硬币图个吉利。和家人一起做饭，充满了温暖和欢笑。

items.sent: A Phone Call to Grandma. Every Saturday evening, I call my grandma, who lives alone in her hometown far away. I tell her about my school life and my little brother. She always listens carefully and laughs at my funny stories. Sometimes she teaches me old songs on the phone. Grandma says my voice makes her day. Although we cannot see each other often, the telephone line carries our love across hundreds of kilometres.
items.sentZh: 给奶奶打电话。每个星期六晚上，我都给独自住在远方老家的奶奶打电话。我给她讲我的学校生活和弟弟的趣事。她总是认真听，被我逗得直笑，有时还在电话里教我唱老歌。奶奶说，我的声音让她一天都开心。虽然我们不能常见面，但电话线把我们的爱传过千山万水。

items.sent: My Weekend Plan. This weekend is going to be busy but interesting. On Saturday morning, I will finish my homework first. In the afternoon, I am going to play football with my friends. On Sunday morning, I will visit the science museum with my father and watch a 3D film about dinosaurs. In the afternoon, I plan to help Mum clean the house and cook a simple dinner. A good plan makes life full and free of rush.
items.sentZh: 我的周末计划。这个周末会既忙碌又有趣。周六上午我先完成作业，下午和朋友们踢足球。周日上午和爸爸去参观科技馆，看一部关于恐龙的3D电影；下午我打算帮妈妈打扫房间、做一顿简单的晚饭。好的计划让生活充实而不慌乱。

items.sent: Traffic Rules. Traffic rules are made to keep everyone safe, so we must follow them. When the light is red, stop and wait; when it turns green, we can go. We should walk on the pavement and cross the road at the zebra crossing. Never play or chase each other on the road, and don't ride too fast. At the same time, drivers mustn't drive after drinking. Safety comes first, for ourselves and for others.
items.sentZh: 交通规则。交通规则是为了保障每个人的安全而制定的，所以我们必须遵守。红灯停，绿灯行；走路要走人行道，过马路要走斑马线；不要在道路上玩耍追逐，骑车不要太快。同时，司机绝不能酒后驾车。无论为了自己还是他人，安全永远第一。

items.sent: The Gift of Music. Music is a wonderful gift in our life. When I am tired, soft music helps me relax; when I am sad, an exciting song gives me power. I started learning the violin at the age of six. Practising is sometimes boring and my fingers hurt, but I never want to give up. Last month I performed on stage for the first time, and the audience clapped warmly. Music makes my life colourful.
items.sentZh: 音乐的礼物。音乐是生活中一份美妙的礼物。疲惫时，轻柔的音乐让我放松；难过时，一首激昂的歌曲给我力量。我六岁开始学小提琴。练琴有时很枯燥，手指也会疼，但我从不想放弃。上个月我第一次登台演出，观众报以热烈的掌声。音乐让我的生活丰富多彩。

items.sent: Growing Up. Growing up is like climbing a mountain. When I was a small child, my parents did everything for me. Now I am a middle school student, and I am learning to do things on my own: washing clothes, cooking simple dishes and making decisions. Sometimes I make mistakes, but mistakes teach me lessons. Growing up also means caring about others, not only myself. I know the road is long, but every step makes me stronger.
items.sentZh: 成长。成长就像爬山。小时候，父母为我打理一切。现在我是中学生了，正学着自己的事情自己做：洗衣服、做简单的饭菜、自己做决定。有时会犯错，但错误给我教训。成长也意味着关心他人，而不只是自己。我知道路还很长，但每一步都让我更强大。

items.sent: An Email to a Pen Friend. Dear Lucy, how are you? Thank you for your last email and the photos of your school in London. They are really amazing. I'd like to tell you about my school life in China. We start school at eight and have seven lessons a day. My favourite subject is English. After class, I often play table tennis with my friends. Please write back and tell me about your hobbies. Best wishes, Li Hua.
items.sentZh: 给笔友的电子邮件。亲爱的露茜：你好吗？谢谢你的上一封邮件和伦敦学校的照片，真是太棒了。我想讲讲我在中国的学校生活。我们八点开始上课，每天七节课。我最喜欢的科目是英语。课后我常和朋友们打乒乓球。请回信告诉我你的爱好。祝好，李华。

items.sent: The Old Photo Album. Yesterday I found an old photo album in the drawer. In the photos, my parents were young and thin, and I was a little baby in Mum's arms. There were also pictures of our old small house and my father's first motorbike. Time flies, and so many things have changed. Mum said every photo is a piece of memory. I will keep the album well, because it records our family's love and story.

items.sent: Never Give Up. Thomas Edison failed more than a thousand times before he invented the light bulb. When he was young, his teachers thought he was not clever, but he never stopped trying.
